_meta.purpose: EMR Phase-3 EXTENSION family: the post-screen offer leg the request family cannot measure (its sessions end at the request turn, so under the signed screen-first rules the terminal is the screen question). Each case continues past the screen with a naturalistic answer supplying onset+duration, measuring the full loop: request -> screen -> answer -> first-line offer.
_meta.comparator_note: NOT a comparator against the 2026-07-31 baseline (different turn structure). Cited only as the loop-closure measurement in the Phase-3 packet.
_meta.fixture_independence: answer turns are naturalistic phrasings; no turn is a lexicon entry verbatim (CI-checked by the detector suite's family scan pattern).
